I did a complete reinstall of SPTarkov and updated it to 3.2.3 then I downloaded my KWM mod and installed it, had the usual first crash upon opening the trader and then everything is working fine after with no crashes and all images loaded.

If you are having issues with the install.

-copy and paste that folder into the /user/mods
-when the game has loaded, open my trader, the game will crash, once it has crashed, open the game as normal and open my trader, slowly scroll to the bottom until all the parts have loaded in as the game needs to remember them all. From the sounds of it you are missing the bundle files for the mod which is why they aren’t showing up. Please try these steps and see it works as it should.

Also do note, this mod will work 100x better on a SSD if you are using a hard drive, it loads the parts the faster.
If you are using a old profile, you should clean the temp files - if that doesnt work, try creating a new profile.

If its a mod conflict, not my problem.

Hope this helps!

comments.author: Arokar
comments.body_html:
I suggest installing SPT on a SSD. Otherwise, if installed on a harddrive you are going to have to wait until all the parts are loaded in, meaning the icon images for all the weapons and weapon parts when you open the trader, you have to let that load. It will take multiple times if installed on a harddrive. It takes once or twice on a SSD.

Once it crashes, open the game again, load the trader and rinse and repeat. It helps if you dont scroll, and then the first lot is loaded, scroll down section by section.

Its just a thing that happens with custom traders when having to many parts and it also depends on your hardware.

Once they are all loaded in, you wont have to worry about it again as the game/profile remembers the parts the next time you open the game. If you start a new profile however, you will have to rinse and repeat.

Hope this helps.

comments.author: Arokar
comments.body_html:
YOUR GAME IS SUPPOSED TO CRASH WHEN USING KWM WHEN LOADING THE TRADERS!

Sometimes it will only crash once, sometimes it can crash 20 times, and sometimes it won’t crash. It depends on your hardware, meaning RAM, CPU, GPU, and whether or not it is installed on an SSD or a hard drive.
I recommend having a minimum of 16g of ram, 6cores/6threads or higher CPU, 6g or higher GPU and make sure it’s installed on a SSD.

Some things that help with loading the mod to stop crashes.

1. Open a KWM trader; do not scroll down; let the first lot of items load; if it crashes, open the game and select the same trader; do not scroll again; let the items load; when the items have loaded, scroll down one row at a time, letting each row load before you do the next row; this helps reduce stress when loading.

2. Before opening a KWM Trader, go to any other trader and set the weapon parts and mods to vital parts, gear mods, or functional mods, as this will load fewer parts, which will reduce the game’s stress to load the items.

3. Once all the items have loaded, they will cache themselves so everytime you now log into your profile, they should already be preloaded which will stop the crashing. The crashes may return if you turn your computer off. (I leave my PC in sleep mode so it’s never really off and never forgets the cached items)

Thank you heaps, hope this helps and you enjoy the mod, have fun!
